column1: card|landscape 3:2|a single blank cream index card lying flat, seen exactly top-down. Slightly aged paper with soft visible fibres and faintly rounded corners, completely blank, no lines. Perfectly rectangular and axis-aligned, no tilt.

slip|landscape 3:2|a single blank narrow cream paper telegram slip lying flat, seen exactly top-down, wide and short, with one softly torn perforated left edge. Completely blank. Axis-aligned, no tilt.

stamp|portrait 2:3|a single office rubber stamp standing upright, straight-on side view: turned dark walnut handle on top, antique brass collar, flat brass base plate at the bottom. Symmetrical, orthographic.

magnifier|square 1:1|a single detective magnifying glass lying flat, seen exactly top-down: round antique brass rim with a clear see-through glass lens, turned dark walnut handle pointing to the lower right corner. The glass area should be mostly transparent with only faint reflections.

drawer|landscape 3:2|the front face of ONE library card-catalogue drawer, straight-on orthographic front view: a dark aged walnut rectangular drawer front with a brass label holder containing a blank cream paper label in the upper middle, and a brass cup pull handle below it. Only the drawer front, perfectly rectangular, axis-aligned, filling the frame.

blotter|landscape 3:2|a single desk blotter pad lying flat, seen exactly top-down: a large rectangle of deep bottle-green leather with four antique brass corner pieces and a thin dark walnut border. Empty surface. Perfectly rectangular, axis-aligned.

lamp|square 1:1|a single classic banker's desk lamp, straight-on front view: antique brass stem and base, long deep green glass shade, switched on with a soft warm glow visible only on the underside of the shade. No light beam drawn in the air.

mic|portrait 2:3|a single vintage 1940s ribbon studio microphone on a short desk stand, straight-on front view: antique brass body with fine horizontal grille slats and a dark walnut base. Symmetrical.

dial|square 1:1|a single round rotary selector knob seen exactly top-down: knurled antique brass outer ring, deep green leather inlay disc in the centre, and one short engraved pointer line at the 12 o'clock position. Perfectly circular, symmetrical.

table|square 1:1|a single round meeting table seen exactly top-down from directly above: dark walnut outer rim, wide deep bottle-green leather inlay, one thin inlaid brass ring. Perfectly circular, empty surface, no chairs.

compass|portrait 2:3|a single antique brass drafting compass (pair of dividers) lying flat, seen exactly top-down, legs opened to a narrow upside-down V shape with the hinge at the top. Fine engraved brass, steel points.

watch|square 1:1|a single open-faced antique brass pocket watch lying flat, seen exactly top-down: cream enamel dial with simple plain tick marks only (no numerals at all), two slim dark hands, crown and ring loop at the top. Perfectly circular case.

gavel|square 1:1|a single judge's gavel, straight-on side view: dark walnut mallet head with two antique brass bands, held horizontal at the upper left, with the walnut handle running diagonally down to the lower right corner.

beetle|square 1:1|a single museum insect specimen seen exactly top-down: one scarab-like beetle with an iridescent deep bottle-green shell and antique brass coloured legs spread symmetrically, with one small round brass pin head in the centre of its back. Symmetrical, head pointing up.

gear|square 1:1|a single antique brass clockwork gear wheel lying flat, seen exactly top-down: evenly spaced square teeth all around, five curved spokes, round hub with a centre hole. Perfectly circular and symmetrical. The gaps between spokes are transparent.

seal|square 1:1|a single round wax seal seen exactly top-down, in a muted warm coral-red wax with a soft irregular melted edge, embossed in the centre with one simple plain raised ring shape (a perfect circle outline, nothing else).
padlock|portrait 2:3|a single heavy antique brass padlock, straight-on front view, shackle closed, with a small plain keyhole plate in the middle of the body. Symmetrical, orthographic.
key|landscape 3:2|a single antique brass skeleton key lying flat, seen exactly top-down, perfectly horizontal: ornate round bow on the left, long shaft, simple bit on the right.

pen|square 1:1|a single classic fountain pen lying flat, seen exactly top-down, on a diagonal with the brass nib pointing to the lower left corner: deep bottle-green lacquer barrel with antique brass bands. Cap removed and not shown.

strongbox|landscape 3:2|a single small document strongbox, straight-on front view, lid closed: dark walnut body with antique brass corner bands, brass lock plate with keyhole in the centre front, brass carrying handle on top. Symmetrical, orthographic.

strongbox-open|landscape 3:2|a single small document strongbox, straight-on front view, with its hinged lid standing fully open upright at the back: dark walnut body with antique brass corner bands, brass lock plate with keyhole in the centre front, empty interior lined with deep bottle-green leather. Symmetrical, orthographic.

tag|portrait 2:3|a single blank cream paper luggage tag hanging straight down, seen straight-on: rectangular with two clipped top corners, a small antique brass eyelet at the top, and a short loop of natural twine through the eyelet. Completely blank.

fan-body|portrait 2:3|a single antique desk fan WITHOUT any blades and WITHOUT any guard cage, straight-on front view: only the round antique brass motor housing with a small centre spindle hub at the top, a short neck, and a heavy round dark walnut and brass base. The area around the motor is empty. Symmetrical.

fan-blades|square 1:1|a single four-blade antique brass fan propeller on its own, seen exactly front-on: four identical rounded paddle blades evenly spaced around a small round centre hub. Perfectly symmetrical, centred, nothing else.
